yaml.description: Reporting automation, data platforms, analytics, applied AI, and governance designed to make the next move clear.

markdown.markdown:
```{=html}

Services

Systems that remove the work between data and decisions.

Start with one high-value workflow or build the foundation for a broader data and AI capability. Either way, the work should be useful, governable, and maintainable.

Featured engagement

Reporting
Automation Sprint

Manual reporting hides its true cost in handoffs, repeated checks, and decisions made from yesterday's version. This focused engagement turns one recurring workflow into a reliable, documented system your team can use.

Tell us what you report ↗

What it produces

A mapped workflow, connected inputs, tested transformations, a decision-ready output, documentation, and a clear handoff.

Best for teams that

Spend too much time assembling recurring reports, reconcile the same numbers across systems, or need a trusted view before making an operational decision.

  1. 01

    Map the workflow

    Sources, handoffs, calculations, and the decision.

  2. 02

    Automate the pipeline

    Inputs, transformations, validation, and refresh.

  3. 03

    Deliver the decision layer

    Output, documentation, and handoff.

Broader capability

Build what the
decision needs.

01

Data Platforms & Integrations

When this helps
Your systems do not share a dependable source of truth.
What we build
API connections, operational data paths, warehouse foundations, and governed models.
What changes for your team
Less manual reconciliation and a clearer path from source to trusted data.
02

Analytics & Decision Systems

When this helps
Metrics exist, but the decision they should support remains unclear.
What we build
Dashboards, analytical products, comparison views, and decision-ready reporting.
What changes for your team
People can find the relevant signal and act with shared context.
03

Applied AI & Workflow Tools

When this helps
Search, classification, summarization, forecasting, or assistance could remove friction.
What we build
Human-in-the-loop AI workflows and internal tools shaped around real work.
What changes for your team
AI has a defined job, a visible boundary, and a useful place in the process.
04

Governance & Ongoing Improvement

When this helps
The cost of an unclear, untraceable, or brittle workflow is high.
What we build
Documentation, validation, access controls, monitoring, and improvement loops.
What changes for your team
Your system is easier to understand, operate, review, and maintain.

Working principles

Useful is a
high bar.

  • Start with the decision.
  • Build for maintainability.
  • Keep humans in control.
  • Leave the client team with clarity.

A practical first conversation

Bring us the workflow
that keeps repeating.

Start a project ↗
```
